versions.content: The DcmModeRule shall evaluate all referenced DcmModeCon- ditions and/or nested DcmModeRules either by a logical AND in case DcmLogical- Operator is set to DCM_AND or by a logical OR in case the DcmLogicalOperator is set to DCM_OR. In case only a single DcmModeCondition or DcmModeRule is ref- erenced the DcmLogicalOperator shall not be present and therefore not be used.
